pages.text: $(bold)The Harbinger$() and $(bold)Ignis$() hold $(bold)Frontier ore$().$(br)$(bold)Hovering Inferno$() and the $(bold)totem captains$() hold the $(bold)final rail$().$(br)$(bold)Scylla$() holds the sea.$(br)$(bold)Ender Guardian$() (the End) holds the lost capital's last secret.$(br2)What that is, the survivors did not write down.
